5	| R-89 | 2026-08-04 | **WP-4C-1 AUTHORIZED TO PLAN AND IMPLEMENT — Execution Governance · Authorization · ARB CHIEF (PREPARED).** **DECISION: Option A. WP-4C-1 — `AdjudicationFailureDeclared` (the domain event, its outbox hydrator, and its catalog deliverable) — is AUTHORIZED. Engineering may prepare the EP-01 plan; implementation follows normal engineering governance.** **VERIFICATION, seven checks:** **(1) single owner — ✅ Adjudication** (R-88). **(2) scope internally coherent — ✅** event announces PM-7's fact, hydrator serializes it for the outbox, catalog registers it; the same triple WP-6 delivered for `AdjudicationExpired`. **(3) required inputs exist — ✅** `AdjudicationProcessState::concludeFailureDeclared(EvidenceSet, IssuedByAuthority, Reason, DateTimeImmutable)` exists (PM-7, WP-2) and records `consideredEvidence · concludedByAuthority · reason · concludedAt`; **every candidate payload field is already on the record.** **(4) required outputs defined — ✅** EPIC-004K §10 fixes the business occurrence — *“the evidence was insufficient; no ruling can issue”*; `AdjudicationExpired(ChallengeRef, DateTimeImmutable)` is the shape precedent. **(5) no unresolved governance dependency — ⚠️ QUALIFIED, see the finding below.** **(6) no Contestation design required — ✅** WP-6 is the governing precedent: `AdjudicationExpired` was announced as published language while its consumer (WP-6B) remained a separate package. **Announcing does not require the consumer to exist.** **(7) WP-4C-2 not implicitly authorized — ✅ expressly not**, see below. **⚠️ FINDING ON CHECK 5 — THE CATALOG DELIVERABLE'S MECHANISM IS UNSETTLED, AND THE TWO PRECEDENTS DIVERGE.** `Canonical_Event_Catalog_v1.0.md` is **FROZEN** and states its own rule: *“Changes follow ADR-T5 (**version, never mutate**).”* **Evidence gathered:** `AdjudicationExpired` **is NOT in the catalog**, yet WP-6 shipped it with a registered hydrator (`app/Contexts/Adjudication/Infrastructure/Outbox/AdjudicationExpiredHydrator.php`) and WP-6 was accepted. `ChallengeRouted` **is** in the catalog — **but at v1.0, dated 2026-06-26, i.e. it predates WP-3A**; so **no work package has been shown to have added a row to the frozen catalog.** **Consequence: the roadmap's *“catalog entry”* wording may mean a NEW CATALOG VERSION (ADR-T5), or may not be required at all on the WP-6 precedent. That is a SCOPE-INTERPRETATION question, not a missing governing rule — ADR-T5 already governs how the catalog changes.** **Authorization is therefore NOT withheld:** deliverables 1 and 2 are unambiguously executable, and **EP-01 exists precisely to resolve scope before implementation.** **OBLIGATION PLACED ON THE PLAN: the EP-01 plan MUST resolve the catalog deliverable against ADR-T5 and the WP-6 precedent, and MUST NOT resolve it unilaterally if the answer requires a new catalog version — that is a Board act and must be escalated from the plan, not absorbed into it.** **WHAT IT CHANGES:** WP-4C-1 may be planned and implemented; §WP-4 gains an executable package. **WHAT IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CHANGE:** — **WP-4C-2 is NOT authorized, not implicitly and not by adjacency**; it remains blocked on EPIC-004K §15.3, Contestation-side · — **no catalog is edited and no catalog version is created** by this ruling · — **§15.3 is not answered** · — **§WP-4 remains OPEN** and **WP-4D unauthorized** · — **WP-8 remains DEFERRED** (R-79) · — **§10's second consumer (Collection-side, COL-5a) remains UNASSESSED** — EP-03 gathered no evidence and this ruling makes no claim · — **no new architectural principle is introduced**; every check above applies an existing one. **⚠️ PROVENANCE: ISSUED BY THE ARB CHIEF — PREPARED, NOT ADOPTED.** R-88's adoption was a SINGLE ACT that expressly left the PREPARED→ADOPTED mechanism in force and created no standing delegation, so this ruling awaits the Decision Authority. **One sentence of confirmation converts it to ADOPTED.** | WP-4C-1 **authorized to plan and implement** (PREPARED). Catalog deliverable carries a scope question the EP-01 plan must resolve or escalate. **WP-4C-2 not authorized** |
6	
7	## R-90
8	
9	| R-90 | 2026-08-04 | **DISCOVERY BOUNDARY CONFIRMATION (WP-4C-2) — Governance · Application of existing governance · ARB CHIEF (PREPARED).** **When ENGINEERING-ACCESSIBLE DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE has been exhausted: engineering discovery ENDS · business semantics become the DOMAIN OWNER'S responsibility · and engineering shall NOT invent candidate business meanings under the label of discovery.** **⚠️ NUMBERING CORRECTION RECORDED AT ISSUE: this ruling was put forward as “R-89”. R-89 WAS ALREADY TAKEN — *WP-4C-1 AUTHORIZED TO PLAN AND IMPLEMENT*, filed 2026-08-04. Filing a second R-89 would have given one number two decisions and corrupted the register's identity. Issued as R-90; the collision is recorded rather than silently renumbered.** **EVIDENCE:** WP-4C-2's Phase A and Phase B reports — the Context Map settled corrective ownership (COL-5a), §10/§15.3 named the disposition and left it open, and the aggregate guards settled reachability; **no examined artefact states what business fact ends the waiting period or whether a challenge survives a failed adjudication.** **SCOPE, as the issuing authority framed it:** **this is NOT a new governance principle — it is the APPLICATION of existing governance to THIS commission**, and it is deliberately not promoted to methodology. **ES-006.1 stands: one work package is not a standard.** **WHAT IT CHANGES:** WP-4C-2's discovery is CLOSED; the Phase C clarification package (Phase B §7/§7a) is put to Contestation. **WHAT IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CHANGE:** — it authorizes **no** tactical design and **no** implementation · — it does **not** answer §15.3 · — it does **not** allocate COL-5a's mechanism · — **D3 and D4 remain held** · — and it creates **no standing rule** for other work packages. **⚠️ PROVENANCE: ISSUED BY THE ARB CHIEF — PREPARED, NOT ADOPTED.** R-88's adoption was a single act that expressly left the PREPARED→ADOPTED mechanism in force and created no standing delegation. **One sentence of confirmation adopts it.** | WP-4C-2 discovery CLOSED; clarification package put to Contestation. **Commission-scoped, not promoted. PREPARED pending the Decision Authority**  **⛔ WITHDRAWN BEFORE ADOPTION 2026-08-04 (annotation; the text above is unchanged and retained).** **The Decision Authority ruled that this is NOT a constitutional decision but the ARB's ACCEPTANCE of a discovery commission's conclusion** — *“R-89 already governs authorization · the discovery report concludes · the ARB accepts the report · governance stops.”* **The register holds constitutional decisions, not operational acceptance.** Recorded instead as **COMMISSION ACCEPTED · DISCOVERY CLOSED · Phase C handed to the domain owner**, in the commission's own artefacts. **The row is retained rather than deleted** — it was filed, and a register that quietly loses a filed row is less trustworthy than one that shows a withdrawal. **⚠️ THE NUMBER R-90 IS RETIRED AND MUST NOT BE REUSED.** Recycling it would recreate exactly the one-number-two-decisions defect caught at R-89 hours earlier. **The next ruling is R-91.** **Nothing depended on this ruling: it was never adopted, and no artefact cites it as authority.** |
